stories.headline: Brown Laid Up in Foxborough - Patriots' Pass Game Runs Thin
stories.read: Well pardner, A.J. Brown took a bad spill in Week 1 and the Patriots just shipped him to the infirmary with a high-ankle sprain - laid up at least four games, maybe more. That's a gut punch for Drake Maye's fantasy value, but it swings the barn doors wide open for Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas, and Mack Hollins to grab a bigger cut of the throws. Go stake your claim on that trio before the rest of the outfit catches wise.

stories.headline: Collins Takes a Limp Into Week 2 - Texans' Receiving Room Runnin' Thin
stories.read: Nico Collins came up lame with a hamstring in Wednesday's practice, and with Jayden Higgins already lost for the year and Tank Dell still nursin' a busted wing on IR, the Texans' receiving corps is running thinner than trail rations. Doctors don't figure it's serious, but his Sunday ride against the Bengals is in jeopardy. If he sits, Kayshon Boutte and Xavier Hutchinson turn into cheap gold on the open range - go pan that creek.

stories.headline: Lawrence Rides In Guns Blazing - Four Touchdowns and Not Lookin' Back
stories.read: Trevor Lawrence rode into Week 1 and shot down the Browns for four touchdowns, no picks, and a career-best day - the saloon's already whisperin' top-five quarterback. That ain't fool's gold, that's a strike. If he was sittin' on your bench or the open range last week, go grab the reins now, 'cause this vein looks fixin' to run all season.
